ex.t: 参与者们纷纷效仿，吃的食物比平时多得多。

defs.def: to play a card of the same suit that has just been played 纸牌游戏

ex.s: We just follow the crowd.
ex.t: 我们只是随大流。

defs.def: to act or behave in the way that sb else has just done 跟着某人做；仿效某人；照着做

ex.s: But if a thin person eats a lot, I’ll follow suit.
ex.t: 但如果一个瘦的人吃很多，我也会跟着做。

defs.def: to add to sth that you have just done by doing sth else 对 … 采取进一步行动； … 后接着

ex.s: A fire drill will be conducted in your residence hall every semester． During a fire drill，please do the following：
ex.t: 每学期都会在宿舍楼进行消防演习。消防演习期间，请遵守以下事项：•在宿舍楼外集合等待进一步指示。

defs.def: to find out more about sth that sb has told you or suggested to you 追查更多情况

ex.s: Which of the following will result in disqualification? （    ）
ex.t: 以下哪种情况会导致取消资格？（    ）

ex.s: The technologist will guide the patient to this modified state—an imaginary world that will disassociate itself more and more from the procedure that follows.
ex.t: 技师会引导患者进入这种改变后的状态——一个想象中的世界，它将越来越脱离随后的操作过程。

ex.s: The results were similar to the first test: the participants followed suit but took significantly more candy when the thin actor took 30 pieces.
ex.t: 结果与第一次测试相似：参与者们纷纷效仿，但当瘦演员拿30块糖果时，他们拿的糖果明显更多。
